knowledgeStatements.statement: Hair-fiber evidence for jojoba is limited to in-vitro or formulation assays: jojoba as a conditioning agent in a thioglycolate straightening emulsion reduced protein loss on Afro-ethnic hair locks in one study, while a later conditioner study found a jojoba-containing conditioner did not significantly reduce combing resistance. These results do not establish hair growth or a general consumer hair-benefit for a neat oil SKU.
